description: Build nextjs-support-desk starter - Support and ticketing with Auth.js, PostgreSQL/Prisma, Resend, and Cloudflare R2. NO monetization provider.
steps: Create nextjs-support-desk/ directory with .gitignore

Create package.json with exact-pinned deps: next@15.3.4, react@19.0.0, react-dom@19.0.0, next-auth (Auth.js v5), @prisma/client, resend, @aws-sdk/client-s3 (for R2 S3-compatible API). DevDeps: typescript@5.8.3, vitest@3.2.1, fast-check@3.23.2, eslint@9.28.0, eslint-config-next@15.3.4, tailwindcss@4.1.10, @tailwindcss/postcss@4.1.10, postcss@8.5.4, prisma, @types/node, @types/react, @types/react-dom

Create starter.json matching catalog entry (id:6, technologies:[TypeScript, Auth.js, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Resend, S3/R2], auth:Auth.js, data:PostgreSQL + Prisma, monetization:None, integrations:[Resend, S3/R2])

Create prisma/schema.prisma with models: Team (id, name, createdAt, updatedAt), Agent (id, teamId, userId, email, name, role enum [admin,agent], createdAt, updatedAt), Ticket (id, teamId, customerId, customerEmail, customerName, subject, status enum [open,in_progress,resolved,closed], priority enum [low,medium,high,urgent], assignedAgentId nullable, createdAt, updatedAt), Message (id, ticketId, authorId, authorType enum [customer,agent], content, createdAt), Attachment (id, messageId, fileName, fileKey, fileSize, mimeType, createdAt). Include initial migration.
Create domain/entities.ts with types for Team, Agent (with AgentRole), Ticket (with TicketStatus, TicketPriority), Message (with AuthorType), Attachment

Create domain/policies.ts with: AuthContext (userId, role, teamId), canCreateTicket (any authenticated customer), canViewTicket (ticket customer or team agent), canReplyToTicket (ticket customer or assigned/team agent), canAssignTicket (admin agent), canCloseTicket (agent or customer). Deny-by-default ownership checks.

Create lib/server/config.ts with ConfigSpec for: NEXTAUTH_SECRET, NEXTAUTH_URL, DATABASE_URL, RESEND_API_KEY, R2_ACCOUNT_ID, R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID, R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, R2_BUCKET_NAME, R2_PUBLIC_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL
Create lib/server/errors.ts with AppError, FileSizeError, FileTypeError, sanitizeProviderError
Create lib/server/auth.ts with Auth.js adapter
Create lib/server/storage.ts with ObjectStorePort interface (uploadFile, deleteFile, getSignedUrl) and R2Adapter using @aws-sdk/client-s3 with MIME/size enforcement BEFORE storage
Create lib/server/storage-fake.ts with FakeObjectStoreAdapter tracking uploads in memory, enforcing same limits
Create lib/server/mail.ts with MailPort (sendTicketCreatedNotification, sendNewReplyNotification) and ResendAdapter
Create lib/server/mail-fake.ts with FakeMailAdapter
Create lib/server/database.ts with Prisma client
Create lib/server/providers.ts
Create middleware.ts protecting /dashboard with Auth.js session check
Create app/page.tsx - public support landing page with create ticket CTA
Create app/auth/ routes for sign-in/sign-out
Create app/dashboard/page.tsx - protected view (customer sees their tickets, agents see team queue)
Create next.config.ts, tsconfig.json, eslint.config.mjs, postcss.config.mjs, vitest.config.ts
Create .env.example with all placeholder values (NO monetization/billing section)
Create tests/unit/domain/policies.test.ts testing ownership and role-based access
Create tests/unit/server/storage.test.ts testing MIME/size enforcement
Create tests/unit/server/mail.test.ts testing ResendAdapter fake
Create tests/integration/ticket.test.ts testing create ticket, reply, close flow
Create tests/integration/auth.test.ts testing authenticated/unauthenticated access
Create tests/property/auth-consistency.test.ts (Property 4) - ownership + team membership
Create tests/property/file-limits.test.ts (Property 3 equivalent) - random file sizes/types always enforced
Create tests/smoke/build.test.ts
Create README.md documenting features (explicitly noting no monetization), setup, deployment
Run pnpm install, lint, typecheck, test, build
acceptance_criteria: nextjs-support-desk/ directory exists with all required files
pnpm install succeeds with committed lockfile
pnpm lint, typecheck, test, build all pass
NO billing/monetization code exists in this starter
File upload limits (MIME type + size) enforced before R2 storage
R2 and Resend adapters have fakes
